comments.author: @goodman8095
comments.text: I was in Zimbabwe. At the airport, customs officers asked me for bribes. In the airport parking lot, police officers demanded bribes. I was fined for carrying a fruit knife while traveling. After shopping at a mall, police officers questioned me and took me to the police station. Foreigners without any illegal behavior are treated like 'living dollars' by Zimbabwean police. There have also been numerous thefts at local markets in Zimbabwe - countless hardships. Please don't be misled by the beautiful scenery
